scope: Administrative evidence intake and immutable responsibility findings, independent of financial approval and execution
implemented: Support records identify reported source and reference; they do not themselves establish liability
Confirmed responsibility requires at least two distinct evidence sources and exact 10000 basis points
Every finding remains immutable; replacement must explicitly reference the current finding
No wallet, order, hold amount, charge or payout is changed by findings
Global live operator permission, employee version, case version, evidence identity and audit are fenced atomically
remaining: Independent entitlement approval and funded execution
Merchant exception payables in scheduled settlements
Remaining custody, partial cash, refund, claim and appeal scenarios
